title: Herre, du har vært vår bolig

request.style: English, Lutheran funeral chorale, a congregation singing slowly in unison with a soft pipe organ, plain even notes, D minor, solemn and consoling, 4/4, 60 BPM, sung in English
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Lord, you have been our dwelling place
Through every age and year
Before the mountains came to birth
You are God, and you are here

[Verse]
You turn us back to dust again
You say, Return, and so we go
A thousand years are in your sight
Like yesterday, gone long ago

[Verse]
At morning grass is fresh and green
By evening it is dry and gone
So teach us, Lord, to count our days
And give us hearts of wisdom

[Verse]
Lord, you have been our dwelling place
Through every age and year
Before the mountains came to birth
You are God, and you are here
